feature_notes:
New usable Rust streaming capabilities: independent interleaved worksheet spools with stable creation order, worksheet dimensions for lazy consumers, and explicit bounded-prefix reads. Writers support active selection, renaming, temporal options before append and deterministic spool cleanup.

The canonical XML codec now uses quick-xml 0.42.0 with migrated UTF-8 event, namespace and XML 1.0 normalization APIs. Includes Windows same-path save replacement fixes since alpha.1.

Rust MSRV is now 1.88.0, verified on Linux and Windows; development and publication tooling uses Rust 1.99. Alpha.1 remains immutable. The three crates are published in dependency order: crabxl-core, crabxl-xlsx, crabxl.

Bounded-prefix reads deliberately skip unread worksheet XML and its CRC; default complete-part reads retain validation. Interleaved writers spool worksheet XML to disk; component allowances are not a process RSS ceiling. Complete structural editing, full feature graphs and baseline parity remain staged. See docs/roadmap.md and docs/decisions/0046-interleaved-streaming-spools.md for limits.
